clinical.citation: Genomic analysis of 11,555 probands identifies 60 dominant congenital heart disease genes (PMID: 40127276)

variants.description: Not specified in the abstract or the available full-text passage; damaging heterozygous variants (de novo and rare transmitted/unphased) in KLF2 were significantly enriched in CHD probands
phenotypes: Congenital heart disease (association with a single cardiac phenotype; specific subtype not stated in the excerpt)

clinical.diagnostic_reason: Significant burden of damaging heterozygous variants (de novo and rare transmitted) in KLF2 among CHD probands after multiple-comparison adjustment. KLF2 was among the 33 genes significantly associated with a single cardiac phenotype (Table 1).

model_organism.citation: Tang et al. 2021 - KLF2 regulates neutrophil activation and thrombosis in cardiac hypertrophy and heart failure progression (PMID: 34793333)
phenotypes: Neutrophil-specific Klf2 loss promotes neutrophil activation and NETosis in the angiotensin II model
Sporadic thrombosis in small myocardial vessels
Myocardial hypoxia, cell death and cardiac hypertrophy
Cardiac dysfunction and heart failure progression
Reduced Klf2 expression in leukocytes of the rodent heart failure model
Crosstalk with HIF1 signaling

model_organism.citation: Chronic NK cell activation results in a dysfunctional, tissue resident-like state mediated by KLF2 deficiency (PMID: 40857665)
phenotypes: Conditional KLF2 deficiency in NK cells (mixed bone marrow chimeras) causes altered homing
NK cells acquire tissue resident-like features in vivo
KLF2 loss/gain-of-function affects NK cytotoxicity, cytokine production and chemotaxis

model_organism.citation: Neutrophil KLF2 regulates inflammasome-dependent neonatal mortality from endotoxemia (PMID: 40170486)
phenotypes: Myeloid-Klf2 deletion decreases survival after endotoxemia in a developmentally dependent manner, with higher mortality at P4 than at P12
Increased proinflammatory cytokines, notably IL-1β, in P4 knockout pups
Greater NLRP3 inflammasome priming and activation and IL-1β release by bone marrow neutrophils
Survival rescued by neutrophil depletion or NLRP3 inhibition (MCC950)
Enrichment of proinflammatory pathways in knockout neutrophils

model_organism.citation: KLF2 maintains lineage fidelity and suppresses CD8 T cell exhaustion during acute LCMV infection (PMID: 39946463)
phenotypes: In vivo CRISPR-Cas9 knockout of Klf2 in CD8 T cells causes aberrant differentiation to exhausted-like cells during acute LCMV infection
Loss of suppression of TOX
Impaired TBET-driven effector differentiation
Loss of the polyfunctional tumor-specific progenitor state

model_organism.citation: Lymph nodes fuel KLF2-dependent effector CD8(+) T cell differentiation during chronic infection and checkpoint blockade (PMID: 40954251)
phenotypes: CD62L+ TPEX and CX3CR1+ TEX developmental lineage depends on KLF2
KLF2 dependence of effector-like exhausted T cell differentiation in lymph nodes during chronic LCMV infection and checkpoint blockade

model_organism.citation: Piezo1-Regulated Mechanotransduction Controls Flow-Activated Lymphatic Expansion (PMID: 35701867)
phenotypes: Lymphatic-specific Piezo1 knockout phenocopies the sprouting defects of Orai1- or Klf2-knockout lymphatics during embryo development (Klf2 knockout lymphatic sprouting defects referenced; Klf2 is a downstream target)
Postnatal Piezo1 deletion causes lymphatic regression in adults

phenotypes: klf2a mutant: atrioventricular valve defects, valvular hypoplasia and absence of leaflets (review table)

biological.citation: 2022 - A mitochondrial contribution to anti-inflammatory shear stress signaling in vascular endothelial cells (PMID: 35695893)
biological.summary: A whole-genome CRISPR-Cas9 screen for genes required for laminar shear stress induction of Klf2 found that induction requires the MEKK2/3-MEK5-ERK5 kinase module plus mitochondrial calcium/ROS signaling and a mitophagy/p62 scaffold. Blocking the mitochondrial pathway in vivo reduced KLF2-dependent genes such as eNOS, and Klf2 expression was limited in regions of disturbed flow.

biological.citation: 2025 - Endothelial SRSF1 Promotes Ischemia-Induced Angiogenesis via ATF3-KLF2-S1PR1 Pathway (PMID: 41195527)
biological.summary: Full-length ATF3, whose splicing is promoted by SRSF1, binds directly to the KLF2 promoter and suppresses KLF2 expression and downstream S1PR1 signaling. This KLF2 suppression enhances endothelial tube formation and angiogenesis after hindlimb ischemia.

biological.citation: 2021 - KLF2 regulates neutrophil activation and thrombosis in cardiac hypertrophy and heart failure progression (PMID: 34793333)
biological.summary: Klf2 mRNA is markedly reduced in leukocytes from human heart failure subjects and a rodent heart failure model. In mice, angiotensin II activates a neutrophil KLF2/NETosis pathway, partly through crosstalk with HIF1 signaling, which drives microvascular thrombosis, myocardial hypoxia and hypertrophy.

biological.citation: 2024 - N6-methyladenosine modification of KLF2 may contribute to endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition in pulmonary hypertension (PMID: 38741032)
biological.summary: METTL3-mediated m6A modification of KLF2 mRNA maintains KLF2 expression, and mutating the m6A site compromises it. KLF2 overexpression restores CD31 and VE-cadherin, reduces SM22, N-cadherin and EndMT transcription factors, and directly binds the SM22 promoter, so it protects against EndMT in pulmonary hypertension.

biological.citation: 2020 - Therapeutic potential of KLF2-induced exosomal microRNAs in pulmonary hypertension (PMID: 32132543)
biological.summary: KLF2 induces exosomal miR-181a-5p and miR-324-5p, which target Notch4 and ETS1 to attenuate pulmonary vascular remodelling. KLF2 and these miRNAs are reduced in pre-clinical, idiopathic and heritable PAH, including a case with the missense p.H288Y KLF2 mutation, and miRNA supplementation attenuates disease in PAH mice.

biological.citation: 2016 - Dendritic Cell KLF2 Expression Regulates T Cell Activation and Proatherogenic Immune Responses (PMID: 27837103)
biological.summary: CD11c-cre conditional Klf2 knockout in dendritic cells increased CD40 and CD86 costimulatory molecule expression and T cell proliferation and apoptosis. Transplanting bone marrow from these mice into Ldlr-/- mice aggravated atherosclerosis, showing that KLF2 restrains DC activation and proatherogenic T cell responses.

biological.citation: 2017 - Regulation of endothelial hemoglobin alpha expression by Kruppel-like factors (PMID: 28825355)
biological.summary: KLF2 and KLF4 gain of function induces HBA in endothelial cells, and endothelial Klf2/Klf4 knockout has the opposite effect. KLF2/KLF4 transactivate the hemoglobin alpha promoter through KLF-binding sites 2, 3 and 4, and ChIP showed KLF4 binding to the promoter.

biological.citation: 2024 - Epigenetic regulation by polycomb repressive complex 1 promotes cerebral cavernous malformations (PMID: 39402138)
biological.summary: Loss of CCM1/CCM2/CCM3 triggers a MAPK-KLF2 signaling cascade. The PRC1 component CBX7 contributes to pathological KLF2 signaling and to activation of KLF2 target genes including TEK, ANGPT1, WNT9 and endoMT genes, and its silencing or inhibition suppresses CCM phenotypes in zebrafish, HUVECs and a murine CCM3 model.

biological.citation: 2021 - G protein-coupled estrogen receptor regulates the KLF2-dependent eNOS expression by activating of Ca(2+) and EGFR signaling pathway in human endothelial cells (PMID: 34363795)
biological.summary: The GPER agonist G-1 increased KLF2 and eNOS expression in EA.hy926 cells and HUVECs through Gαq/Gβγ, Ca2+/CaMKKβ/AMPK/CaMKIIα-HDAC5 and Src/EGFR/ERK5/MEF2C signaling. Silencing KLF2 or GPER attenuated the G-1-induced eNOS expression.

biological.citation: 2013 - Aβ(1-42) disrupts the expression and function of KLF2 in Alzheimer's disease mediated by p53 (PMID: 23313511)
biological.summary: KLF2 expression is decreased in the brains of Tg2576 AD mice because of Aβ accumulation. KLF2 overexpression fully rescued Aβ(1-42)-induced loss of Occludin in human brain endothelial cells (HBMECs), and p53 mediated the Aβ-induced KLF2 reduction.

biological.citation: 2016 - Cross-talk between autophagy and KLF2 determines endothelial cell phenotype and microvascular function in acute liver injury (PMID: 27545498)
biological.summary: KLF2 inducers (statins, resveratrol, shear stress, KLF2 adenovirus) raise endothelial KLF2 through a Rac1-Rab7-autophagy dependent mechanism, and KLF2 in turn activates autophagy, forming a positive feedback loop. Simvastatin maintained autophagy and KLF2 after cold ischemia/reperfusion and improved microvascular function in liver injury.
